note: Phone bot recipes PH-081..136 (2026-10-26), checked by Claude

recipes.title: Double jump
steps: Gravity pulls the sprite down all the time.
Space makes it jump, but only if it has jumps left.
Touching the ground gives the jumps back.

recipes.title: Wall bounce for a ball
q: make a ball bounce off the walls
steps: Green flag: the ball points in a slanted direction.
It moves 5 steps all the time.
If it touches the edge it bounces.

recipes.title: Paddle follows mouse x
q: paddle that moves with my mouse
slide a paddle left and right
steps: The paddle stays at the bottom.
Every moment it copies the mouse x.
So it slides left and right with the mouse.

recipes.title: Breakout ball
q: ball that bounces off paddle and bricks
steps: The ball starts in the middle going up.
It bounces off the edges and the paddle.
If it falls to the bottom, the game stops.

recipes.title: Pong ball with two paddles
steps: The ball moves and bounces off the top and bottom.
When it hits a paddle it turns around.
If it goes past the sides, it goes back to the middle.

recipes.title: Snake head moves on a grid
q: make a snake that moves in steps
steps: Arrow keys choose the direction.
Every little wait the snake moves 20 steps.
That makes it jump from square to square.

recipes.title: Grid step movement
q: move one square at a time
steps: Each arrow key moves exactly 30 steps.
So the sprite hops from tile to tile.
A short wait stops it from racing away.

recipes.title: Camera scroll variable
steps: A scroll variable remembers how far we moved.
Arrow keys change the scroll instead of the sprite.
Other sprites use scroll to shift on the screen.

recipes.title: Parallax two layers
steps: Script 1 goes on the NEAR layer: arrow keys change scrollX and the layer moves the full amount.
Script 2 goes on the FAR layer: it moves only half as much.
Far things moving slower makes it feel deep!

recipes.title: Health bar with costumes
steps: Give the bar sprite 3 costumes: costume1 = 1 heart, costume2 = 2, costume3 = 3.
Health starts at 3. Touching the enemy takes 1 away.
The bar shows the costume that matches the health.

recipes.title: Power-up: faster for 5 seconds
q: go faster for a few seconds
steps: The speed starts at 3.
Touching the power-up sets it to 8.
After 5 seconds it goes back to 3.

recipes.title: Shield on key press
q: make a shield when i press a key
steps: Press s to turn the shield on.
The sprite gets a little see-through and shield is 1.
After 2 seconds the shield goes off.

recipes.title: Dash with key a
q: zoom forward when i press a
steps: Press a to start the dash.
The sprite moves 8 times very fast.
Then it needs a short rest before the next dash.

recipes.title: Knockback when hit
q: push my player back when hit
steps: Green flag: the sprite checks for a hit forever.
When it touches the enemy it turns away.
It is pushed back a few steps and flashes.

recipes.title: Checkpoint saves x and y
q: save my spot in a game
steps: Two variables remember a saved x and y.
Touching the flag spot saves the place.
Press r to go back to the saved place.

recipes.title: Boss with 3 hits
q: make a boss that needs 3 hits
steps: The boss starts with 3 life.
Each time it is hit, life goes down by 1.
When life reaches 0 the boss says it lost and hides.

recipes.title: Day and night backdrop timer
steps: Green flag: the timer starts at 0.
Every 10 seconds the backdrop changes.
So day turns to night and back again.

recipes.title: Animated walk with 2 costumes
q: make my sprite walk with legs
steps: Right arrow moves the sprite.
Each step it changes to the next costume.
A little wait makes the walk look right.

recipes.title: Idle breathing size pulse
steps: Green flag: the sprite grows a tiny bit.
Then it shrinks back a tiny bit.
It repeats forever like breathing.

recipes.title: Talk: 3 lines of dialogue
q: tell a little story with speech
steps: Click the sprite to start talking.
It says three lines one after the other.
Each line waits 2 seconds.
script: I have a secret to tell you.
Follow me to find the treasure!

recipes.title: Chat bot answers yes or no
q: make a bot that answers yes or no
ask a question and get an answer
steps: Green flag: the sprite asks you a question.
It picks a random number 1 or 2.
1 says Yes and 2 says No.
script: Ask me a yes or no question!

recipes.title: Add names to a list in order
q: save what i type in a list
make a list of my friends
steps: Green flag: the list is cleared and shown.
The sprite asks for a name 3 times.
Each answer is added to the end of the list.

recipes.title: Reverse a word
steps: The sprite asks for a word.
It starts at the last letter and goes back to the first.
Each letter is joined onto the end of a new word.

recipes.title: Count letters in a word
q: count the letters in my word
steps: The sprite asks for a word.
It measures the length of your answer.
Then it tells you the number.

recipes.title: Join words into a sentence
q: make a sentence from my words
steps: The sprite asks for a first word and a second word.
It joins them with a space between.
Then it says the new sentence.

recipes.title: Random password from letters
steps: A list holds the letters we can use.
The sprite picks 5 random letters.
It joins them one by one into a password.

recipes.title: Clock with the timer
steps: Green flag: the timer is set back to 0.
Every moment the sprite shows the timer.
The number is rounded so it looks neat.

recipes.title: Stopwatch start and stop
steps: Press s to start: the timer is reset.
Press e to stop and see the time.
The sprite says how many seconds passed.

recipes.title: Metronome beat with a sound
steps: Green flag: the sprite plays a sound.
It waits half a second.
It repeats forever to keep the beat.

recipes.title: Keys play notes
q: press a key to play a sound
steps: Each key plays a sound.
The pitch is changed so each key sounds different.
Clear the effects at the end so it starts fresh.

recipes.title: Teleport between two doors
q: make a door that teleports me
go through a door and appear somewhere else
steps: Green flag: the player checks for the door.
Touching the door sends the player to the other door spot.
A short wait stops it from jumping back right away.

recipes.title: Spawn enemies every 2 seconds
q: make enemies appear again and again
spawn a new enemy every 2 seconds
steps: The first sprite hides and makes a clone every 2 seconds.
Each clone jumps to a random spot at the top.
It then drops down and deletes itself at the edge.

recipes.title: Enemy patrol left and right
q: make an enemy walk back and forth
steps: The enemy walks right for a while.
Then it flips and walks left.
It keeps going forever.

recipes.title: Score popup that floats up
q: show plus points that float up
steps: When the message comes, the popup clone appears.
It floats up a little each moment.
It fades away and then deletes itself.

recipes.title: Confetti clones on win
steps: When the win message comes, it makes 20 confetti clones.
Each clone gets a random colour and spot.
They fall down and delete themselves.

recipes.title: Make a button sprite
q: make a button i can click
steps: The button gets bigger when the mouse is on it.
Clicking it plays a sound and sends a message.
Other sprites listen for the message to start the game.

recipes.title: Collect coins and add score
q: touch a coin and score goes up
steps: Green flag: the score starts at 0.
When the player touches the coin, the score goes up by 1.
The coin jumps to a new random spot.

recipes.title: Countdown timer
q: game ends when time runs out
steps: The time variable starts at 10.
Every second it goes down by 1.
At 0 the sprite says time is up and the game stops.

recipes.title: Lives and game over
q: game over when lives are gone
steps: The lives variable starts at 3.
Touching the enemy takes away 1 life.
At 0 lives the sprite says Game over and the game stops.

recipes.title: Keep a high score
steps: Two variables hold the score and the high score.
When the game ends, the sprite checks if the score is bigger.
If it is, the high score is replaced.

recipes.title: Shoot a bullet
q: fire a bullet when i press space
steps: The bullet sprite hides at the start.
Space makes a clone of the bullet.
The clone flies forward and deletes itself at the edge.

recipes.title: Disappear when touched
q: make a thing vanish when touched
hide when the player touches me
steps: Green flag: the item shows itself.
It waits until it touches the player.
Then it plays a sound and hides.

recipes.title: Jump to a random spot when clicked
q: click the sprite to make it move
steps: When you click the sprite, it plays a sound.
It adds 1 to your score.
Then it jumps to a new random spot.

recipes.title: Drag a sprite with the mouse
q: move my sprite with the mouse
steps: Green flag: the sprite is set to draggable.
In the player you can grab and move it.
Let go to drop it in a new place.

recipes.title: Spin forever
steps: Green flag: the sprite turns a little each moment.
It never stops turning.
A bigger number makes it spin faster.

recipes.title: Orbit around a point
steps: The sprite moves forward a little.
Then it turns a little.
Doing both again and again makes a circle.

recipes.title: Grow bigger on each click
q: make my sprite grow when clicked
steps: Each click makes the sprite 10 bigger.
When it gets very big, it pops.
Then it goes back to normal size.

recipes.title: Rainbow colour cycle
steps: Green flag: the colour effect grows a little each moment.
The sprite goes through every colour.
It never stops.

recipes.title: Bounce off another sprite
q: ball bounces off my wall sprite
turn around when touching another sprite
hit a sprite and go back
steps: The ball keeps moving forward.
When it touches the other sprite, it turns around.
It also bounces off the edges.

recipes.title: Fly a rocket with arrow keys
q: turn left and right and fly forward
steps: Left and right arrows turn the rocket.
Up arrow moves it forward.
It always flies where its nose points.

recipes.title: Maze: stop at the walls
q: go back if i touch a wall
steps: Arrow keys move the player a little.
If it touches the wall, it moves back the same amount.
So it can never go through.

recipes.title: Next level with a new backdrop
q: change the backdrop when i reach the door
steps: The player checks if it touches the goal.
When it does, it broadcasts a message.
The stage listens and switches to the next backdrop.

recipes.title: Gravity: fall down
q: make my sprite fall with gravity
steps: A speed variable gets 1 smaller each moment.
The sprite moves by that speed.
When it reaches the floor it stops.

recipes.title: Simple jump with gravity
steps: Space gives the sprite an upward speed.
Gravity makes the speed smaller each moment.
The sprite lands on the floor and stops.

recipes.title: Fade in at the start
steps: The sprite starts almost invisible.
Each moment it becomes a little more visible.
At the end it is fully there.
